senses.en: happening over a long period and involving a lot of difficulties
examples: Three generations of fishermen are engaged in an [[epic]] struggle against nature, fate, and society in this moving tale.

senses.zh: 英雄的；英勇的；史诗般的
senses.en: telling a long story about brave actions and exciting events
examples: This island is a place of great adventures and [[epic]] tales, inhabited by five tribes.

senses.en: having a rough or pointed edge or surface
examples: For centuries, the Rocky Mountains have captivated visitors with their [[jagged]] peaks, magnificent waterfalls, and blue lakes.

senses.en: smoke, dust, or mist in the air which is difficult to see through
examples: Just as the Sun began to break through an early-morning [[haze]], I spotted three horses on a hill.

senses.zh: 着淡色于···；使带有一点（情绪、特质等）
senses.en: give sth. a small amount of a particular color, emotion, or quality
examples: The light of the setting sun [[tinges]] the buildings with delicate colors.

senses.en: a particular type of red, green, blue, etc.
examples: The bright yellow [[shade]] is meant to evoke the optimistic promise of a sunshine-filled day.

senses.en: slight darkness or shelter from the direct light of the Sun made by sth. blocking it
examples: I spent most of the day walking on the shore or reading a novel in the [[shade]] of a large beach umbrella.

senses.zh: （感情或信念等）长久的，持久的
senses.en: (of a feeling, belief, etc.) lasting for a long time and not changing
examples: My [[abiding]] memory is of him watering his plants in the garden on sunny afternoons.

senses.zh: （尤指精于一门文科学问的）学者
senses.en: sb. who knows a lot about a particular subject, esp. one that is not a science subject
examples: He is internationally recognized as a distinguished [[scholar]] in the field of Chinese studies.

senses.en: sb. who takes complete control of a country or its people
examples: Local people have to obey their [[conquerors]] because they want to go on living.

senses.zh: （通常为了避免碰撞）突然转向一边
senses.en: make a sudden sideways movement while moving forward, usu. in order to avoid hitting sth.
examples: The vehicle [[swerved]] off the road, hit a lamppost and rolled several times before catching fire.

senses.en: move forward or backward while also quickly moving slightly from side to side
examples: The performer shook, jumped and [[shimmied]] in perfect motion, spurring the crowd to rise in an emotional applause.

senses.en: move slowly along on wheels, or make sth. do this by pushing or pulling it
examples: Hundreds of trucks full of fruit and vegetables [[trundled]] across the border each day.

senses.zh: （尤指穿越沙漠地带的）旅行队，商队
（AmE trailer）（带有食宿设备的）旅行拖车

senses.en: (written) knock sb. down with great force
examples: A 25-year-old man was [[felled]] by that boxer with a single punch.

senses.en: cut down a tree
examples: Fifteen million trees were [[felled]] by the Great Storm which hit the south of England in 1987.

senses.en: (lit. or fml.) a danger or problem in a particular activity or situation
examples: These birds are able to survive the [[perils]] of the Arctic winter.

senses.zh: 巨大的危险（尤指受损或被杀）
senses.en: (lit. or fml.) great danger, esp. of being harmed or killed
examples: This was the second time that he had put his life in [[peril]] to rescue someone at risk of drowning.

senses.en: relating to the weather in a particular area
examples: It should be noted that some parts of the world seem to be experiencing [[climatic]] changes.

senses.en: (fml.) move across, over, or through sth., esp. an area of land or water
examples: They crossed the bridge and [[traversed]] the road out into the open country.

senses.en: belonging to an enemy
examples: They warned us that the northern half of the island was controlled by [[hostile]] forces.

senses.zh: 怀有敌意的；敌对的；不好的
senses.en: angry and deliberately unfriendly toward sb. and ready to argue with them
examples: Rebecca was very [[hostile]] toward us and made it clear she didn't want our help.

senses.en: land that is owned or controlled by a particular country, ruler, or military force
examples: The new oil contracts will amount to a half billion dollars' worth of foreign investment in their [[territory]].

senses.en: continue to do sth., although this is difficult, or other people oppose it
examples: He urged the United States to [[persist]] with its efforts to bring about peace.

senses.en: the feeling of wanting or needing a drink
examples: After walking five miles, they had worked up a great [[thirst]] and decided to stop for water.

senses.en: a set of beliefs on which a political or economic system is based, or which strongly influence the way people behave
examples: To put it another way, the analysis lacks both a sense of humanism and a theory of [[ideology]].

senses.en: a mysterious, exciting, or desirable quality
examples: There will always be "lost in translation" moments, but that's part of the [[allure]] of foreign travel.

senses.en: being part of the nature or character of sb. / sth.
examples: The [[intrinsic]] value of a coin is the value of the metal it is made of.

senses.en: the feeling of excitement and adventure that is related to a particular place, activity, etc.
examples: There are plenty of ways to see the country this summer, but few can beat the [[romance]] of traveling on a steam train.

senses.en: an exciting and often short relationship between two people who love each other
examples: Hemingway's [[romance]] with his nurse inspired him to write A Farewell to Arms.

senses.en: believe that sth. sb. does or sth. that happens has a particular meaning
examples: His refusal to work late was [[interpreted]] as a lack of commitment to the company.

senses.en: translate spoken words from one language into another
examples: She couldn't speak much English so her children had to [[interpret]] for her while traveling in the UK.

senses.en: continuing for a long time
examples: The feelings that arise in that condition are simpler, more understandable, and more [[durable]].

senses.en: staying in good condition for a long time, even if used a lot
examples: Fine bone china is very practical due to the fact that it is strong and [[durable]].

senses.en: (fml.) (be a ~ to sth.) prove or show very clearly that sth. exists or is true
examples: The new model is a [[testament]] to the skill and dedication of the workforce.

senses.en: make sb. feel strong admiration
examples: As children, we were [[dazzled]] by my uncle's good looks and charm.

senses.zh: （因强光、闪烁等）使···目眩；使···眼花缭乱
senses.en: makes sb. unable to see properly for a short time
examples: Drivers are supposed to slow down or pull over when they are [[dazzled]] by bright sunlight.

senses.en: repeat exactly the same journey that sb. else has made
examples: They are hoping to [[retrace]] the [[epic]] voyage of Christopher Columbus.

senses.en: go back exactly the way you have come
examples: By trailing a thread behind them spiders are able to drop from any height to the ground and to [[retrace]] their steps with certainty to a particular spot.

senses.en: a.relating or referring to Buddhism
examples: Lingyin Temple is a famous [[Buddhist]] temple situated in the northwest of Hangzhou.

senses.en: n. sb. who believes in Buddhism
(pl. grottos or grottoes) a small attractive cave
examples: This [[grotto]] houses the most exquisite stone sculptures from the Tang Dynasty.

senses.en: move or go somewhere slowly
examples: The crowd [[drifted]] away from the scene of the accident.

senses.en: move slowly on water or in the air
examples: As our boat [[drifted]] down the river, many children ran along the shore waving at us.

senses.en: surrounded by beautiful views of nature
examples: Yosemite National Park is an area of outstanding [[scenic]] beauty and great wilderness value.

senses.en: rock or cloud that is formed in a particular shape, or the shape in which it is formed
examples: Enormous cloud [[formations]] dominate the landscape on a hot, humid summer's day.

senses.en: the process of starting a new organization or group
examples: An agreement on the [[formation]] of a new government was reached on June 6.

senses.en: (pl. oases)
a long narrow raised part of a surface, esp. a high edge along a mountain
(AmE)
vi.spread out or cover a large area of land
examples: The beach [[stretches]] for more than two miles, backed by grassy dunes and sweet-smelling pine forest.

senses.en: push or throw sth. very hard so that it moves through the air very quickly
examples: A loose dog is at the risk of falling or being [[catapulted]] out of the truck bed.

senses.en: a feeling of great respect and liking for sb. / sth.
examples: You might gaze at the Grand Canyon with [[awe]], marveling at its beauty and fearing its depth.

senses.en: an event or situation that makes you feel great sadness
examples: We cannot cure the world of [[sorrows]], but we can choose to live in joy.

senses.en: a feeling of great sadness, usu. because sth. very bad has happened
examples: The president expressed his deep [[sorrow]] over the bombing deaths.

senses.en: involving risk or danger, esp. to sb's health or safety
examples: The report calls for a ban on the import of [[hazardous]] waste.

senses.zh: 无遮掩的；荒凉的；索然无味的
senses.en: exposed, empty, or with no pleasant features
examples: That's probably the most bare, [[bleak]], and inhospitable island I've ever seen.

senses.en: very impressive or powerful, and often frightening
examples: They had to overcome [[formidable]] obstacles during their journey.

senses.en: (of weather or living conditions) very difficult and unpleasant to live in
examples: Penguins employ cooperative behaviors in order to deal with an incredibly [[harsh]] environment.

senses.en: unpleasantly bright
examples: The solar cooker looks impressive, with mirrors designed to catch the [[harsh]] sunlight, focusing their power to create intense heat.

senses.en: the state of suffering and death caused by having no food
examples: Millions of people in that region are threatened with [[starvation]] as a result of drought and poor harvests.

senses.en: (BrE civilisation) a society that is well organized and developed, used esp. about a particular society in a particular place or at a particular time
examples: The ancient [[civilizations]] of Central and Latin America were founded upon corn.

senses.en: (fml.) happen before sth. or come before sb. / sth. in order
examples: It would be helpful if you were to [[precede]] the report with an introduction.

senses.en: the ability to continue doing sth. difficult or painful over a long period of time
examples: Running a marathon is seen by many people as the ultimate test of human [[endurance]].

english: trick sb. into sth. / doing sth.

senses.en: cause sb. to do sth. by means of a trick
examples: Dean [[tricked]] the old lady into giving him 800 pounds, claiming that he would invest it for her.

senses.en: begin a journey by boat or ship
examples: When Captain Cook [[set]] [[sail]] for the Pacific, he was heading to parts of the world that were little-known.

english: during / in / throughout / over the course of sth.

senses.en: during sth.
examples: We struck up a conversation, in the [[course]] of which it emerged that he was a sailing man.

senses.en: have to deal with a problem or difficult situation
examples: The rescue team also had bad weather conditions to [[contend]] with.

senses.zh: 马可 • 波罗 （意大利旅行家）
君士坦丁堡（伊斯坦布尔的旧称）
